''For a summary of all translated versions of The Wheel of Time see [[The Wheel of Time translations]].''

The Wheel of Time translates as ''Kolo času'' in Czech. The series has been fully translated into Czech and is published by Fantom Print. It is currently being republished by Laser, starting in Oct 2022 with the most recent being A Crown of Swords in Feb 2025.

There are also five audiobooks so far, the latest released in 2024. They are narrated by Pavel Soukup.
